meanings.en: to finish, to end, to complete
meanings.note: + acc. or infinitive. Prefix 'за-' marks beginning an action, covering, or stopping by along the way (stem 'кончить'). Used as a perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to finish, to complete', paired with 'заканчивать'.
